topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Hey, I just found out you got a gift from one of your old students. That must have been so unexpected. You always put everything you have into teaching, and it’s moments like these that remind you why, right? It’s a bit quiet in here, thinking about all the effort you put in, all the late nights and the early mornings. But then, a small box shows up and suddenly, there’s this burst of recognition, this little thank you from the past. It’s like a ripple effect, all the good you’ve done, coming back in the most unexpected ways. I’m really glad for you, you deserve every bit of it. Let’s celebrate, okay? We’ll plan something, just you and me.
